ITEM 1 | Pile of fresh raw leafy greens with thin red/magenta stems and veins, dark green glossy oval leaves with slightly wrinkled texture, spread across the upper-left and center of the plate covering roughly 35-40% of the plate's surface, moderately thick mound about 3-4 cm high, dry surface with no visible dressing or sheen beyond natural leaf waxiness, some leaves whole and some torn, a few pale green-white pieces of stem near the lower-left edge | 60

ITEM 2 | Small pale green-white diced pieces, about 1-1.5 cm each, firm and slightly translucent, clustered under the leaves at the lower-left of the pile, dry surface | 8

ITEM 3 | Thin bright red stem fragment, about 2 cm long, lying at the lower edge of the lower leaf, dry and fibrous | 1
